name: sharpps-work
description: General office/documentation tooling for solutions built on the SharpPS framework: capturing real screenshots of authenticated web apps via a headless browser (including local multi-tenant/reverse-proxied instances where the real domain doesn't resolve to the dev environment), generating genuine OpenXML Word (.docx) documents with embedded screenshots, headings, and tables via python-docx, turning a codebase in any language into a queryable knowledge graph via the codebase-memory-mcp MCP server, and writing short, humanized Findings/Feedback/Conclusion documentation on a workspace feature to docs/structured-documentation/.
